params.attribution: package energy is the whole machine's: each scenario with an energy source also meters an equal window with nothing launched (a11y_poll: its own sleeping window) and reports attributable = window minus baseline, as mean watts; noisy on shared VMs
params.energy_source.note: rapl: no intel-rapl package zones in /sys/class/powercap (VM or unsupported CPU)
params.prefill.energy_note: rapl: no intel-rapl package zones in /sys/class/powercap (VM or unsupported CPU)
params.prefill.flow: doubletap's drafters (draft fixture corpus, text-only retrieval), read-ahead on with min_interval_ms 0; Drafter::prewarm_idle and one read-ahead unmetered, then N read-aheads of distinct tasks back to back, each waited for, metered on llama-server
params.prefill.model: qwen3-4b-q4km (Qwen3-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf, local llama-server llama-server-linux-x86_64-cpu (b11940), thinking off)

metrics.name: energy.prefill.completed
metrics.description: Read-aheads that completed in the metered window

metrics.name: energy.prefill.seconds_per_read_ahead
metrics.description: Mean wall time of a completed read-ahead (prompt build, retrieval and prefill)

metrics.name: energy.prefill.cpu_s_per_read_ahead
metrics.description: llama-server CPU time over the metered window per completed read-ahead
